text:
jess: morning all, i'm jess (joined eng-runtime today) :wave:. Quick onboarding snag: i can't open the Grafana dashboards or Datadog monitors. Okta hands me a 403 on the app. Who's the right person to add me to 'inference-observability' and to the Grafana infra folder?

kevin: welcome jess :tada: — i can take this. can you confirm your okta email and whether you have an existing Datadog invite? sometimes the invite lands in spam.

jess: jess.wu@redwood.com. no invite landed. trying datadog.redwood.com redirects to okta and then 403.

okta-bot: okta-bot: detected failed app assignment for jess.wu@redwood.com to "Redwood Datadog". Created identity ticket IDP-3194.

kevin: thanks. i'll open an infra ticket to add you to the Datadog team and request Grafana viewer perms. infra-bot will post the invite. In the meantime, try accessing Grafana directly: https://grafana.redwood.com/dashboards/f/infra/inference-costs. If you still get blocked it's definitely entitlement mapping.

jess: tried the direct link, same 403 after okta.

infra-bot: infra-bot created TICKET-2104: "grafana invite + datadog team add for jess.wu@redwood.com". Owner: kevin. ETA 12h. Grafana invite will be sent to jess.wu@redwood.com once infra team approves.

anya: adding a note — Sentry org also requires security approval for membership. If you need crash-level alerts for your service, include the service name and justification. Also we require 2FA on Sentry, so please enable it once you accept.

kevin: filed SENTRY-441 to request Sentry member add (service: runtime-agent). tagged @anya for approval.

jess: thanks — small follow-up: do folks use a shared Grafana account for dashboards or personal SSO? i saw some dashboards in a repo — can i clone/edit them?

kevin: we use SSO accounts (no shared creds). Dashboard definitions are stored in infra/grafana/dashboards in the platform repo. Editing dashboards requires Grafana edit permission; that is granted sparingly. If you want to suggest a change, open a PR to the repo with the JSON model or a dashboard patch and ping eng-runtime owners for review.

kevin: quick snippet to find dashboard definitions locally:
```
repo:platform git grep -n "inference-costs" -- infra/grafana || true
```

jess: got it. also seeing a dashboard called "p95-by-model" — is that Datadog or Grafana?

kevin: p95-by-model exists in both. Grafana imports the Datadog metrics via the Datadog datasource. For edit workflows, update the grafana JSON + add any new queries in Datadog as saved queries. If you need help mapping metrics names (we have several naming conventions), ping me and i'll share the metric-mapping doc.

kevin: infra-bot reports the Grafana invite was sent. check your inbox (and spam).

jess: invite arrived — accepted — i can view dashboards! still waiting on Datadog access.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Datadog team add completed for jess.wu@redwood.com -> team: inference-observability. You should be able to view monitors and dashboards.

jess: confirmed — Datadog works now. i can see monitors and the cost dashboard. big help, thanks :heart:!

anya: approved Sentry membership for runtime-agent, invite should arrive. reminder: enable 2FA before accepting.

jess: Sentry invite received and accepted, 2FA set up. everything seems in order. one request: can someone point me to the alerting playbook for paged incidents? want to read the runbooks for the infra alerts.

kevin: docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability/alerts-runbook. start with the 'inference-critical' section. if you want a quick tour i can DM you and show common dashboards + alert rules.

jess: that would be awesome — appreciate the warm welcome!

kevin: welcome aboard again. added a quick note to the new-hire checklist: expect identity/team adds to take up to 12h for infra actions and up to 24h if security approval is required.

jess: noted, thanks everyone for the fast turnaround :raised_hands:
